c: Open On-Call Scheduling › On-Call Schedules in the classic interface. Agents with itil can read it.
say: Open on-call scheduling, then on-call schedules, in the classic interface. Support agents can read it.

c: Use My, All or Pinned On-Call Schedules, and search by Group / Schedule.
say: Use the my, all or pinned tabs, and search by group or schedule.

c: The card shows who is on call now, or Nobody is On-Call now. On pdi2 no group has a shift yet.
say: The group's card shows who is on call now, or that nobody is. On pdi2 no group has a shift yet, so the cards are empty.

c: Open the person for their email, contact number and manager; Show escalation details gives the order of contact.
say: Open the person for their email, phone number and manager. Show escalation details gives the order in which people are contacted.

c: In a Sidebar discussion on an incident, problem or change, adding a group with a shift adds only who is on call.
say: In a sidebar discussion on an incident, problem or change, adding a group with a shift adds only the people on call.
